annotations.title: List the articles of an Iranian law

description: List the articles of one Iranian law in order, 50 per page, each with its title and slug, headed by the law's article count and number of pages. Use it to browse a law's structure or to find an article's slug, with a law slug from find_law; then get_law_article reads an article in full. It lists titles, not text, and is not a search: for articles about a subject use search_iranian_law. A page past the end comes back empty and says so.

law_slug.description: The law's slug as find_law returns it.

page.description: Which page of 50 articles, from 1; the first result gives the number of pages.

name: list_law_articles

links.description: The dadrasai.com pages the result cites, in order.

text.description: The result, in Persian, as it should be quoted.
